messages.content: Return only JSON matching the supplied schema. Synthesize a production decision packet for the Platform Node Inducer's first external paid induction. Treat every fact below as bounded evidence, not authority to contact anyone, publish, activate payment, spend, or mutate another settlement. Settlement law: root is a seller micro-enterprise, not a central runtime; every border crossing requires a declared contract; customer territory is sovereign; root must be absent after delivery. Active proof goal: one independently controlled non-Union customer pays under a root-owned priced offer and exact bilateral contract; a bounded territory becomes a sovereign Agentic Metro-Enterprise able to operate, refuse, transact, attest, amend, and improve; preserve digest-linked offer, assent, delivery, customer outcome, payment receipt, and seller book entry; pass refusal, replay, idempotency, resource-ceiling, and refund/rollback tests; second sovereign settlement validates seller-local fixture. Current state: root owns no product implementation yet. SDSS returned an exact refusal because its implementation bundle did not bind the awarded bid; authoring/registering that provider-local bundle awaits an explicit Leader grant. Change Services enterprise-induction-team owns the six-step semantics: discover, determine minimal machinery, install locally, exercise, certify, withdraw, but is chartered and not built. General Counsel office has contract-forming authority but lacks an executable contract service and bilateral register. Stripe Payment Acceptance Enterprise is a separate rail; it cannot own seller offer, fulfillment, entitlement, customer relationship, or books; live catalog, price, tax/refund, payout/dispute authority require Leader decisions. Finance may discover a border price from seller ask plus buyer bid but may not select it. Current Stripe evidence: domestic online cards 2.9% plus $0.30; ACH debit 0.8% capped at $5; international cards add 1.5%, currency conversion adds 1%; original processing fees are generally not returned on refunds; webhooks require raw-body signature verification and may duplicate; POST idempotency keys and event-ID deduplication are required; refund/dispute races can duplicate customer credits. Minnesota Revenue says custom software made for a particular customer after consultation and analysis is generally not taxable, while prewritten software is taxable; a mixed reusable/custom induction needs professional classification before sale. FTC guidance supports minimizing sensitive data and putting vendor security, use, retention, deletion, and verification duties in contracts. Market evidence is broad: Upwork reports AI engineering roughly $25 to over $100/hour and custom business automation around $6,000 starting; Clutch reports many reviewed development projects at $10,000 to $49,000; one FY26 specialist consulting schedule lists $235 to $325/hour senior roles. These are comparables only, not a selected price. Required recommendation constraints: sell the full bounded pilot induction, not readiness alone; a paid readiness assay may be credited to the full service; do not assert a defensible production amount before provider cost evidence and an independent buyer bid; require exact two-party promises and formation/acceptance/cure/discharge terms; qualify independence without collecting unnecessary identity data; outreach service is presently absent; second validator must be sovereign and separately contracted. Produce concise recommendations, exact gates, nondelegable Leader choices, and limitations. Do not claim legal or tax advice and do not invent an existing provider or completed proof.

productScope.recommendation: Sell the full bounded pilot induction as a single priced offer covering all declared required steps: discover, determine minimal machinery, install locally, exercise, certify, and withdraw. A paid readiness assay may serve as a credited entry point but must not be sold as a terminal deliverable. Root must be absent after delivery; the customer territory must become a fully sovereign Agentic Metro-Enterprise on completion.
productScope.readinessRole: A readiness assay may be offered as a discrete paid entry point credited toward the full induction price if the customer proceeds. Both the assay and the full induction require separately formed bilateral contracts. The assay price and credit mechanism are Leader decisions and must be documented in the offer before publication.
productScope.successBoundary: Success requires exactly one independently controlled non-Union customer who pays under a root-owned priced offer and exact bilateral contract; whose territory becomes a sovereign Agentic Metro-Enterprise able to operate, refuse, transact, attest, amend, and improve without root presence; and whose transaction is preserved as a digest-linked chain of offer, assent, delivery, outcome, payment receipt, and seller book entry.

pricingMethod.recommendation: Do not assert a defensible production price before provider cost evidence is obtained and an independent buyer bid is received. Finance may discover a border price from seller ask and buyer bid but may not select it; selection is a nondelegable Leader decision. Market comparables — Upwork AI engineering $25 to over $100/hr, custom automation starting ~$6,000; Clutch projects $10,000–$49,000; specialist consulting $235–$325/hr — establish range plausibility only and may not be cited to customers as binding references. Price must survive professional tax classification before publication.
pricingMethod.marketEvidenceUse: Upwork, Clutch, and the FY26 specialist consulting schedule are bounded comparable data establishing a plausible price range. Finance uses them to bracket the seller ask and evaluate buyer bid reasonableness. They may not be cited to customers as binding reference prices, used to select a production price, or treated as authoritative outside their documented scope.
requiredInputs: Provider cost evidence for the induction implementation bundle
Independent buyer bid from a qualified non-Union customer
Professional tax classification: custom vs. prewritten or mixed software per Minnesota Revenue rules
Seller ask formally documented by root before border-price discovery can begin
Leader selection of the final offer price from the Finance-discovered border-price range
Stripe cost basis (domestic card 2.9% + $0.30; ACH 0.8% capped $5; international adds 1.5%; FX adds 1%) factored into margin analysis

legalPreconditions: GC office must build an executable bilateral contract service and bilateral register before any offer is extended to a customer.
Every bilateral contract must state exact formation, acceptance, cure, and discharge terms; browse-wrap or implied assent is insufficient.
Every border crossing requires a declared contract; root must be absent from the customer territory after delivery is certified.
Contract must not reserve root runtime authority post-delivery; the customer territory must be fully sovereign on completion.
SDSS implementation bundle must be authored and registered under explicit Leader grant before any contract can bind the awarded bid.
Change Services enterprise-induction-team must be built, not merely chartered, before the six-step induction semantics can be executed.
Professional tax classification of the induction — custom, prewritten, or mixed — must be obtained before any price is published or sale proceeds.
Contract must bind vendor duties on security, data use, retention, deletion, and verification consistent with FTC minimization guidance.
The formed bilateral contract must be recorded in the GC bilateral register at the moment of formation, before payment is activated.
Seller offer must be root-owned; Stripe Payment Acceptance Enterprise may not own the offer, fulfillment, entitlement, or customer relationship.
Contract must specify refund, rollback, and dispute terms and must disclose that original Stripe processing fees are not returned on refunds.
Customer refusal rights and cure terms must be explicit and operable by the customer without root intervention after delivery.
Customer data collected for independence qualification must be minimized; no sensitive identity data beyond what qualification requires may be collected.
Second sovereign validator must be independently contracted and may not share contract terms, formation event, or register entry with the first customer.
paymentControls: Stripe is a payment rail only; it may not own the seller offer, fulfillment, entitlement, customer relationship, or books.
Live catalog, price, tax and refund configuration, payout settings, and dispute authority require explicit Leader decisions before activation.
All Stripe webhook handlers must verify the raw-body HMAC signature before processing any event; do not parse the payload before verifying.
Event-ID deduplication is required; the billing ledger must reject any event already recorded by its Stripe event ID.
Idempotency keys are required on all POST charge operations; the same key must be safely reusable and must not produce a second charge.
Webhook delivery may duplicate; payment-receipt recording must be idempotent so repeated delivery of the same event does not double-credit the seller.
Refund and dispute races can duplicate customer credits; the ledger must detect and reject duplicate credit entries before committing.
Domestic online card rate is 2.9% plus $0.30; ACH debit is 0.8% capped at $5.00; both must be factored into margin before Leader price selection.
International cards add 1.5%; currency conversion adds 1.0%; Leader must decide whether root absorbs or passes these through before any international offer is published.
Original Stripe processing fees are generally not returned on refunds; this must be disclosed in the contract and in the published offer terms.
Seller book entry must be recorded from the payment receipt event, not from Stripe payout, to preserve audit trail and digest-chain integrity.
No payment may be activated or charged before the bilateral contract is formed and its entry is recorded in the GC bilateral register.
customerQualification: Customer must be non-Union and independently controlled; qualification must confirm this without collecting unnecessary identity data.
Independence is evidenced by separate legal existence, no runtime dependency on root, and autonomous capacity to operate, refuse, and transact.
Customer territory must be capable of becoming a sovereign Agentic Metro-Enterprise upon delivery without any root presence remaining.
Customer must have legal capacity to form a bilateral contract in their own jurisdiction; capacity confirmation must be documented.
Customer data collected during qualification must be minimized per FTC guidance; vendor duties on retention and deletion must be contractually bound.
No qualification process may be initiated until a Leader-authorized outreach service is built and operational.
Customer must affirmatively assent to the exact bilateral contract text; implied, click-wrap, or browse-wrap assent is not sufficient.
Customer jurisdiction's treatment of the induction for tax purposes should be confirmed before the final price is set for that customer.
Second sovereign customer must be separately qualified; qualification evidence may not be shared with or derived from the first customer's file.
assurancePlan: Refusal test: customer exercises contractual refusal; system must halt delivery, record the refusal event in the digest chain, and trigger rollback without root intervention.
Replay test: delivery is replayed after a completed induction; system must detect prior completion and return an idempotent result without re-executing.
Idempotency test: payment POST is submitted twice with the same key; the ledger must record exactly one charge and reject the duplicate without error.
Resource-ceiling test: induction runs against a customer territory at the declared ceiling; system must not exceed it or fail silently.
Refund/rollback test: customer triggers a post-delivery refund; system must initiate rollback, record the event, and prevent duplicate credit from a webhook race.
Digest-chain verification: offer, assent, delivery, customer outcome, payment receipt, and seller book entry must each be retrievable and mutually linked by digest reference.
Root-absence audit: after delivery is certified, a post-delivery audit must confirm root retains no runtime presence in the customer territory.
Second-sovereign validation: a separately contracted second customer must independently complete the full induction and pass all behavioral tests above.
structured_output.outreachStatus: The outreach service is presently absent. No mechanism exists to contact, solicit, or qualify external customers. No outreach action — including contact, publication, or solicitation — may occur until a Leader-authorized outreach service is built and operational. This packet does not authorize outreach. The absence of an outreach service is a hard stop: the induction pipeline cannot advance to customer qualification until a Leader decision clears this gate and the service is constructed.
leaderDecisions: Grant SDSS explicit authority to author and register the provider-local implementation bundle that binds the awarded bid.
Authorize construction of the Change Services enterprise-induction-team so the six-step induction semantics can be executed.
Authorize construction of an executable GC bilateral contract service and bilateral register.
Authorize construction of an outreach service; no customer contact or solicitation may occur before this authorization and construction.
Formally document the seller ask and direct Finance to begin border-price discovery.
Select the final offer price from the border-price range discovered by Finance; this decision is nondelegable.
Authorize activation of live Stripe catalog, price, tax and refund configuration, payout settings, and dispute handling.
Decide whether root absorbs or passes through international card surcharge (1.5%) and currency conversion fee (1.0%).
Decide whether a paid readiness assay will be offered as a credited entry point and set its price and credit terms relative to the full induction.
Approve the minimum-data standard for customer independence qualification before any qualification process is initiated.
Authorize formation of the second sovereign validation contract, confirming it is separately formed from the first customer's contract.
stopConditions: SDSS implementation bundle is not authored or registered under a Leader grant.
Change Services enterprise-induction-team is chartered but not built; six-step semantics cannot be executed.
GC bilateral contract service and bilateral register do not exist.
No Leader-selected offer price exists; Finance has not completed border-price discovery.
Outreach service is absent; no customer contact or qualification may begin.
